scope: Three of the four identified method gaps. No model was run: the GPU was reported busy, so the XPU operator tests are written but not executed.

gap_1_edit_surface.what: Input-side (read) projection operator alongside the existing write-back one.
gap_1_edit_surface.writeback: dW = -s * d.T @ (d @ W); needs out_features == hidden. o_proj/out_proj, down_proj.
gap_1_edit_surface.read: dW = -s * (W @ d.T) @ d; needs in_features == hidden. q/k/v, gate/up.
gap_1_edit_surface.why_it_matters: Under GQA, k_proj/v_proj write num_kv_heads*head_dim < hidden, so the write-back operator cannot be expressed on them at all. A write-back-only tool cannot edit k/v.
gap_1_edit_surface.groups: full adds attn_in and mlp_in; each side has its own searched strength
gap_1_edit_surface.refusals: row normalization on the read side; fused-expert read side; unknown edit_targets
gap_1_edit_surface.surface_llama_2x: 14 targets (7 projections x 2 layers), up from 4

gap_2_layer_selection.measurement: score[l] = ||mean_bad[l]-mean_good[l]|| / pooled_spread[l], normalized by its own max to [0,1]
gap_2_layer_selection.semantics: replaces the searched center/width/floor shape rather than multiplying with it; applied strength = strength * profile[layer]
gap_2_layer_selection.scope: only methods whose operator is a plain per-layer projection; leace and ara are rejected at validation because they carry their own factors
gap_2_layer_selection.search: profiled mode suggests only strength per group, not shape parameters the operator never reads

gap_3_strength.config: strength_range: [lo, hi], explicit opt-in; widening the range widens the search space

gap_4_expert_granular_moe.why: Per-expert directions need per-expert activation statistics, which means a per-architecture router capture path (hook the router, attribute tokens to experts, accumulate per-expert means). Each MoE architecture routes differently, and the result cannot be verified without a real MoE model on the GPU.
gap_4_expert_granular_moe.current_behaviour: Fused expert tensors are already edited (not dense-only), but one direction is broadcast across every expert.

bugs_found_by_tests: strength_range unpacked before its length was validated, so [0.] raised a bare unpacking TypeError instead of a clear error
a writeback-surface assertion was passing vacuously: source_path has no .weight suffix, so an endswith(".weight") check could never match

test_state.xpu_note: Ran on the real B70 once the GPU freed (30.6 GiB free, Intel Arc Pro B70). Includes the new read-side export-parity test.
test_state.read_side_export_parity: test_full_surface_survives_streamed_export_on_the_b70: 14-tensor read+write edit -> streamed export -> reload, logits bit-identical

honest_limits: No checkpoint has been ablated. These are operators, validation and measurements, not refusal-quality evidence.
The read side is not shown to be more effective than the write-back side, or by how much.
The discriminative profile is not shown to beat a searched shape on a real model.
No checkpoint has been ablated: the B70 tests prove the read-side operator and its export parity on a 2-layer random model, which is mechanics, not refusal quality.
